items.title: Black Forest National Park
items.summary: Explore the world-famous Black Forest, known for its thickly wooded, mountainous terrain and unique mystique. It's a great destination for families seeking natural beauty and outdoor adventures.

items.title: Adventures Begin Here – End of Summer Fest
items.summary: Celebrate the end of summer with live entertainment, contests, an interactive equipment display, food trucks, and family activities, including family fun tournaments.

items.title: Beetlejuice Jr. Auditions
items.summary: Youth aged 8 to 18 can audition for a 60-minute adaptation of the Broadway musical 'Beetlejuice Jr.' Show dates are in October and November.

items.title: Kaiserslautern’s End of Summer Car Show
items.summary: Participate in or attend a car show featuring categories like Best European, Muscle Car, American Car, JDM, and Old Timer. Open to military-affiliated ID card holders.

items.title: Latin Nights at the Rheinlander!
items.summary: Enjoy a vibrant Latin Night with live music from the Salsa Band Borinkuba, playing Salsa, Merengue, and Bachata. Food is available, making it a great evening out for adults.
items.dateHint: last Friday of the month, 9 p.m. to 1 a.m.

items.title: Summer Reading Program Block Party
items.summary: Join the Baumholder Library for a block party with games, entertainment, food, prize giveaways, and community partner stands. Free and open to all ages.
items.location: Pavilion 1, Smith Barracks (across from Wagon Wheel Theater)

items.title: Black Forest National Park
items.summary: Explore one of Germany's most beautiful national parks, offering four-season hikes, diverse animal life, waterfalls, and lakes. The Ruhestein visitors center is a great starting point.

items.title: Freudenstadt
items.summary: Visit this overlooked gem in the Black Forest, featuring a beautiful and historic city marketplace, fountains, and good weather. Its layout is based on an ancient board game.

items.title: Hoher Ochsenkopf Trail
items.summary: Hike this trail in the northern Black Forest National Park, known for rare and endangered species and the 'Hurricane' portion of the trail. The peak is nearly 1,054 meters high.
items.location: Hoher Ochsenkopf, Black Forest National Park

items.title: Schliffkopf Nature Reserve Hike
items.summary: Enjoy some of the best hiking in the Black Forest, with a reasonably easy peak hike offering incredible views of the Rhine Valley. You might spot deer or snakes.

items.title: Triberg
items.summary: Discover this Black Forest destination famous for its waterfalls and a fascinating cuckoo clock museum, which houses the world's largest cuckoo clock, over two stories tall.

items.title: Minions & Monsters (2026)
items.summary: Enjoy this animated comedy about the Minions conquering Hollywood, unleashing monsters, and then trying to save the planet from the chaos they created.

items.title: Moana (2026)
items.summary: Watch Moana answer the Ocean's call and voyage beyond her island with demigod Maui to restore prosperity to her people in this family-friendly animated adventure.

items.title: Sketch (PG) Free Admission
items.summary: Attend a free screening where a grieving girl's drawings come to life, wreaking havoc and forcing her family to confront their grief and track down the creatures.

items.title: The Odyssey (2026)
items.summary: Experience King Odysseus's treacherous journey home after ten years of war, facing deadly monsters and vengeful gods in this adventure film.

items.title: Young Washington (2026)
items.summary: Discover the untold story of young George Washington as he fights to survive and confronts global conflict, testing his honor and courage.
